name: backend_engineer

categories.label: System Design & Architecture
categories.description: Distributed systems patterns, microservices vs monolith trade-offs, caching (Redis/Memcached), message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and concurrency/async programming.

categories.label: API & Database Engineering
categories.description: High-throughput REST/gRPC API development, SQL/NoSQL schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, transactions, and ORM proficiency.

categories.label: Cloud, DevOps & Reliability
categories.description: Containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), logging, and APM observability.

categories.label: Code Quality & Testing
categories.description: Unit/integration testing suites (pytest, jest), clean architecture, documentation, security best practices, and code review standards.

bonus_criteria: Demonstrated experience scaling systems to >10,000 QPS, cloud architecture certifications, or authoring foundational libraries.
deductions_criteria: Zero evidence of automated testing, lack of version control, or absence of database design experience.
